name: TableStyle
description: Represents a single style that can be applied to a table or slicer.
remarks: A table style defines the formatting for one or all of the elements of a table, PivotTable, or slicer. For example, a column is an element of a table. A table style can define that columns in a table are formatted with alternating formatting (also known as banding or stripes).

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: NameLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the object in the language of the user. Read-only String.

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: True if the style is a built-in style. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ShowAsAvailableTableStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets a table style shown as available in the table styles gallery. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowAsAvailablePivotTableStyle
properties.description: Sets or returns whether a style is shown in the gallery for PivotTable styles. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowAsAvailableSlicerStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the specified table style is shown as available in the slicer styles gallery. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAsAvailableTimelineStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the specified table style is shown as available in the timeline styles gallery. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the TableStyle object and returns a reference to the new copy.

parameters.name: NewTableStyleName
parameters.description: The name of the new table style.
